## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what changes and why. For documentation, state whether decision status changes.

## Scope and traceability

Linked REQ/AC/decision IDs; approval evidence for scope changes; what remains proposed.

## Validation

List commands actually run and observed results, plus manual review evidence. Mark tests not run clearly. Do not claim app checks for this documentation-only starter.

## Relevant risks and release limits

Describe permission, sensitive-data, safeguarding, accessibility or AI effects where relevant. State outstanding gates and rollback if implementing behavior. No production deployment is implied by merge.
